superseded_reviews.anatomy_basis: Krishna and human figures use ordinary two-arm, two-leg anatomy; visible cattle and calves are separate quadrupeds. The stanza has no multi-limbed deity depiction.

limbs_hands_feet.observations: The enlarged right-hand view shows a thumb and four fingers. Yashoda’s hand overlaps the other Krishna wrist and obscures its thumb; both dangling feet show five toes each.

attachment_proportions.observations: Krishna’s two arms join at the shoulders and both dangling legs attach at the cart edge; Yashoda’s hand lies over one wrist without a detached arm.

faces.observations: Krishna and Yashoda have separate readable faces; the plain forehead and bare visible ear match the shared Krishna contract.

duplication_fusion.observations: One Krishna sits with Yashoda on the central wagon; the caravan people and cattle remain separate despite overlap in depth.

text_artifacts.observations: No readable writing, caption, watermark or signature appears on the wagon, cloth or frame.

scene_style_continuity.observations: The caravan scene remains coherent and Krishna’s earring and wrist bands are removed. Krishna cheek B-R 36 and upper-arm B-R 44; Yashoda R-B 128 and Nandagopan R-B 124; one Krishna thumb is obscured.
